tasks.title: Add Interpersonal line taxonomy dimensions (Section 2.9)

AC-08: Cross-references link to Interpersonal Line Stage Map, Interpersonal modules (EI-08 through EI-11), Emotional & Interpersonal Safety Addendum

tasks.title: Add Emotional line progression ladder (Section 3.8)
acceptance_criteria: AC-09: Four levels defined (L1–L4) with names, criteria to enter, example practices, and developmental line focus for each

AC-10: L1 'Emotion-Aware' — emotion wheel journalling entry; L2 'Emotionally Literate' — ABC chain analysis, reappraisal; L3 'Self-Regulating' — somatic tracking, affect labelling in conversation; L4 'Emotionally Facilitative' — designing emotion practices, co-regulation facilitation
AC-11: Criteria for advancing specified per level
AC-12: Fallback alternatives documented: reduce duration/intensity, shift to cognitive reflection for somatic destabilization

tasks.title: Add Interpersonal line progression ladder (Section 3.9)
acceptance_criteria: AC-13: Four levels defined (L1–L4) with names, criteria to enter, example practices, and developmental line focus for each

AC-14: L1 'Relational Observer' — perspective accuracy verification; L2 'Skill Builder' — Four Horsemen self-audit; L3 'Dialogue Practitioner' — PACE attunement, NVC repair drafting, cross-difference dialogue; L4 'Relational Facilitator' — facilitating cross-difference dialogue, designing relational practices
AC-15: Criteria for advancing specified per level
AC-16: Fallback alternatives documented: solo written exercises when no partner available, reduce scope before skipping
